name: services
description: Services found in OpenTelemetry logs, with log, warning and error counts (requires Import OpenTelemetry services)

config.postBody: {{ (() => { const svc = dataSource.otelServiceField || 'resource.service.name.keyword'; const layout = svc.match(/^(.*)service[.]name([.]keyword)?$/) || ['', '', '']; const attr = (name) => (layout[1] || '') + name + (layout[2] || ''); const ts = dataSource.otelTimestampField || '@timestamp'; const sev = dataSource.otelSeverityField || 'severity.number'; const names = (typeof service !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(service)) ? service.map((o) => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]) : []; const tf = typeof timeframe !== 'undefined' ? timeframe : null; const span = (tf && tf.start && tf.enum !== 'none') ? { gte: tf.start, lte: tf.end, format: 'strict_date_optional_time' } : { gte: 'now-24h' }; const filter = [ { range: { [ts]: span } } ]; if (names.length) { filter.push({ terms: { [svc]: names } }); } return { size: 0, track_total_hits: false, query: { bool: { filter: filter } }, aggs: { services: { terms: { field: svc, size: 1000 }, aggs: { warnings: { filter: { range: { [sev]: { gte: 13, lt: 17 } } } }, errors: { filter: { range: { [sev]: { gte: 17 } } } }, environment: { terms: { field: attr('deployment.environment'), size: 20 } }, environmentName: { terms: { field: attr('deployment.environment.name'), size: 20 } }, k8sNamespaces: { terms: { field: attr('k8s.namespace.name'), size: 50 } }, k8sDeployments: { terms: { field: attr('k8s.deployment.name'), size: 50 } } } } } }; })() }}
